Get AI-powered advice on this job and more exclusive features.

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1000+ colleagues in 70+ countries and very few office based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder led, profitable and growing.

We are hiring a Customer Success - Team Manager.

To support Canonical's growth, we are expanding our CSM team globally and recruiting leaders to help our team of Customer Success Managers across regions. We consider our Customer Success operations an exceptional tool to sustain revenue retention and growth, placing excellence in delivering outstanding customer services in the new technologies sector. As such, we are looking for exceptional candidates with proven track records in Customer Success and an obvious passion for new technologies. Ideally, you have been a Customer Success Manager at one point in your career and naturally evolved to a leading position.

You will enjoy this role if you are organised, persistent, analytical, diplomatic, a listener, hard-working, and determined to grow your skills and teams. As a lead, you are to provide mentoring, coaching in post-sales account management and feedback to team members. You play a crucial role in proactively identifying areas of improvement and implementing process change, driving high-performing teams. You are comfortable dealing with ambiguity and quickly adapt to changes. You seek collaboration with other teams to enhance the overall customer experience. Your key responsibility is to analyze regional performance metrics, identify trends and opportunities for improvement, and implement changes to increase efficiency and achieve business objectives. You will work hand-in-hand with the Head of Customer Success.

CSMs engage a diverse customer base and follow diverse CSM motions to provide the appropriate level of focus for every customer. The right candidate would adapt to this diversity and bring broad experience to the team.

Location: This is a globally remote role

The role entails:

  • Strategic planning and analysis: preparing communication plans, Team Meetings, and other messages shared in broader management forums, setting yourself and your team up for success. Regularly reviewing key performance indicators and metrics is your baseline. You develop strategies to enhance customer engagement, improve retention rates, drive upsells or cross-sells where appropriate, and ultimately increase customer success.
  • Customer interactions and support to your team: you resolve escalated customer issues requiring expertise or intervention. You work closely with your team members to ensure timely resolution.
  • Team management: you are passionate about guiding and supporting your team members, helping them navigate complex customer situations, improve their skills, and achieve their goals. You are ready for regular performance reviews with team members. While your help in identifying areas for improvement is key, you are asked to celebrate excellence, recognise your team's achievements, and set goals for individual growth within the team.
  • Cross-functional collaboration: collaboration with other departments, such as Sales, Marketing, Product development, and Support, is essential. This ensures alignment on customer needs, feedback sharing, and coordinated efforts to drive customer success. You establish trustworthy channels of communication across the board.
  • Documentation and reporting: you are allowed to be creative! While building content with your team and your manager, you also ensure the changes are well documented, instilling quality and attention to detail in all you do.

What we are looking for in you

  • Excellent academic results at school and university
  • Bachelor's or equivalent degree in Business, Communication or STEM
  • Knowledge and passion for Customer Success, revenue management and technology, experience in SaaS or software industries
  • Track record of bringing exceptional Customer Success experience results
  • Commitment to continuous learning and improvement - curious, flexible, scientific
  • Creative problem-solving and cross-team collaboration
  • Experience growing and developing a CSM team
  • Hands-on approach to using data to drive team activities and continuous improvement
  • Willingness to travel up to 4 times a year for internal events

Nice-to-have skills

  • We at the Customer Success team strongly appreciate various languages! Therefore, if you possess proficiency (both written and spoken) in Japanese, Korean, Spanish, Portuguese, German, French, or Italian, alongside an excellent command of English, please inform us!

What we offer you

We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.

  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person - we've been working remotely since 2004!
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues from your team and others
  • Priority Pass for travel and travel upgrades for long haul company events

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since its inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

title: Design Director, UI/UX & Brand
description:
About Darkroom

Darkroom is a technology-driven growth marketing firm focused on growth-stage consumer companies. Founded in 2017, we build on a universal AI commerce layer called Matter, employing senior human resources enriched by an agentic technology stack to enhance output, efficiency, and revenue generation for our clients. Our team has delivered billions of dollars in trackable revenue across e‑commerce, direct-to-consumer, and social commerce programs, accelerating results through high‑impact digital strategies that unlock revenue growth, transform marketing operations, and prioritize profitability.

The Role

We are hiring a Design Director—a visionary leader with a strong design background, driving high‑quality design execution across various platforms and managing creative talent. You’ll combine strategic oversight with hands‑on involvement, ensuring every design project meets the highest standards of excellence.

Responsibilities
  • Lead 1–3 UI/UX engagements, focusing on branded e‑commerce websites.
  • Emphasize branded UI, conversion‑focused UX and clear design approaches.
  • Present design work to clients, explaining design choices based on effective reasoning and UX principles.
  • Manage design projects independently from discovery to hand‑off, adhering to timelines and collaborating with developers to ensure feasibility.
  • Develop component systems and maintain design guidelines for consistency.
  • Manage a team of designers, starting with 2–4 direct reports and expanding as the team grows; provide strategy, project management, design feedback, performance evaluation, and escalation handling.
  • Conduct weekly 1:1s with direct reports to assess client health, offer feedback and oversee career development.
  • Ensure high‑quality work output, focusing on visual craft, UX expertise and meeting deadlines.
  • Collaborate with cross‑functional teams—marketers, strategists, developers, and clients—to develop project plans, understand business objectives and address client issues.
  • Refine internal processes for client work in coordination with the Director of Creative; provide training and feedback to enhance the skills of the design team.
Qualifications
  • 3–6+ years of senior‑level web design experience with e‑commerce companies; at least 1 year of people‑management experience preferred.
  • Digital portfolio showcasing web design and branding skills—color theory, hierarchy, composition, typography.
  • Self‑motivated, proactive, detail‑oriented with strong sense of ownership.
  • Experience collaborating with developers and documenting designs for development hand‑off.
  • Comfortable with client‑facing responsibilities in English, leading discovery calls and resolving client feedback.
  • Ability to provide constructive internal feedback and guide direct reports.
  • Ability to tackle ambiguous problems, understand business challenges, design solutions and execute them effectively.
  • Proficiency in Figma (Auto Layout, Components, Variants) and Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator); bonus: familiarity with HTML/CSS or frameworks like Tailwind.
Remote & Compensation

Fully remote role operating in EST time zone, 100% conducted in English. Benefits include flexible parental leave, remote‑first culture, growth opportunities, autonomy with accountability, and a high‑bar performance environment.

Equal Opportunity

Darkroom is an equal‑opportunity workplace—dedicated to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national orientation, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements.

title: Senior Manager, Event Logistics
description:
Senior Manager, Event Logistics

Department: Tournament and Venue Operations

Location: Brazil

Description

FIFA27 will be established as the Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil, to work together with FIFA HQ in Zurich and globally, to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ ("FWWC2027"). Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

Key Responsibilities
  • Overall responsibility for the management, coordination and leadership of the Logistics team and sub‑projects.
  • International freight forwarding, including the international movement and customs clearance of goods into and out of the host country.
  • Conception and implementation of simplified customs procedures together with involved government authorities to ensure smooth importation and exportation of goods for all tournament stakeholders.
  • Central warehousing, including asset tracking within the warehouse and across all venues where assets are provided by Logistics.
  • Material planning, including the gathering of Furniture, Fixture and Equipment (FFE) requirements from all functional areas, working with Procurement in sourcing and delivery.
  • Domestic distribution of FFE, FIFA assets, uniforms and other commodities; movements of team luggage and equipment to/from hotels, airports, stadiums and training sites and between host cities.
  • Managing the entry of delivery and collection vehicles into venues during the tournament period via the Master Delivery Schedule System (MDS).
  • Providing Venue Logistics Services, including unloading services, determining storage space requirements of Logistics and other functional areas, distribution of items inside venues, and provision of FFE.
  • Where required, development of IT solutions for Master Delivery Schedule (MDS), Material Planning tool, Venue Delivery Portal (VDP), and Logistics Customer Relationship Management tool (LCRM).
  • Procurement and management of golf‑cart pool at venues.
  • Development of a dissolution strategy in cooperation with tournament management, legal, procurement and all item‑procurement functional areas.
  • Evaluation of the local logistics market and contracting a Logistics Service Provider (LSP) to provide warehousing, trucking and people resources as required.
  • Managing established contracts (LSP, FFE‑ and golf‑cart provider) and ensuring all project milestones, deadlines and KPIs are met.
  • Providing the Logistics Concept of Operations and other project integration‑management documentation such as Functional Area Operational Plan (FAOP) and Standard Operational Plan (SOP) as required.
  • Attending site/venue visits, workshops, logistics activities, meetings and events where an Event Logistics presence is required (e.g., Team Workshop, Broadcaster Meetings, Partnership Workshops).
  • Creating and managing the Event Logistics budget in cooperation with FIFA Zurich Event Logistics.
  • Creating and managing the Event Logistics project plan, including mitigation and communication of risks and issues in cooperation with FIFA Zurich Event Logistics.
  • Recruiting the Logistics team and providing leadership to the team.
  • Preparing and managing a health‑and‑safety plan.
  • Preparing and managing a sustainability and environmental plan related to the Event Logistics Project.
  • Providing timelines and accurate reporting to FIFA Zurich Event Logistics and Senior Management.
  • Completing the final reconciliation, closing contracts and transferring knowledge post‑tournaments.
Your Profile
  • Minimum of 15 years of experience in Major Event Logistics or event operations for an international event.
  • Knowledge of event logistics planning and project management processes.
  • Team player, willing to work to tight timelines.
  • Strong analysis, reporting and data skills.
  • Able to work in a fast‑paced, multi‑level, project‑based event environment with emphasis on timelines and delivery.
  • Positive attitude, patience and persistence.
  • Proven track record in managing complex projects, preferably international sports events.
  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written).
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written).
  • Ability to relocate to Rio de Janeiro.
Seniority level

Mid‑Senior level

Employment type

Contract

Job function

Management and Manufacturing

Job Description

Job Number:

General Manager (Hilton Barra Rio de Janeiro) (Job Number:HOT0BOG6 )

Work Locations

Work Locations: Hilton Barra Rio de Janeiro Avenida Abelardo Bueno Barra

A General Manager is responsible for managing the Hotel Executive team and overall hotel targets to deliver an excellent Guest and Member experience while managing profitability and guest satisfaction measures.

A General Manager is responsible for managing the Hotel Executive team and overall hotel targets to deliver an excellent Guest and Member experience while managing profitability and guest satisfaction measures.



What will I be doing?

As a General Manager, you are responsible for managing the Hotel Executive team and overall hotel targets to deliver an excellent Guest and Member experience. A General Manager will also be required to manage profitability and guest satisfaction measures. Specifically, you will be responsible for performing the following tasks to the highest standards:

  • Manage ongoing profitability of your hotel, ensuring revenue and guest satisfaction targets are met and exceeded
  • Lead in all key property issues including capital projects, customer service, and refurbishment
  • Ensure all decisions are made in the best interest of the hotels and Hilton
  • Deliver achievable hotel budgets, and set other short- and long- term strategic goals for the property
  • Provide effective leadership to hotel team members
  • Lead in all aspects of business planning
  • Comply with and exceed Hilton Brand Service Standards
  • Ensure costs are controlled and revenue opportunities are effectively sourced and delivered
  • Manage and develop the Hotel Executive team to ensure career progression and effective succession planning within Hilton
  • Hold regular briefings and communication meetings with the HOD team
  • Respond to audits to ensure continual improvement is achieved
What are we looking for?

A General Manager serving Hilton brands is always working on behalf of our Guests and working with other Team Members. To successfully fill this role, you should maintain the attitude, behaviours, skills, and values that follow:

  • Experience as General Manager or Director of Operations within a similar quality hotel
  • Degree or diploma in Hotel Management or equivalent
  • Possesss strong commercial acumen, with experience in increasing profitability
  • Experience managing budgets, revenue proposals, and forecasting results in a similar sized property
  • Excellent leadership skills
  • Exceptional communication skills
  • In-depth knowledge of the hotel/leisure/service sector

It would be advantageous in this position for you to demonstrate the following capabilities and distinctions:

  • General Management experience in a similar quality hotel


What will it be like to work for Hilton?

Hilton is the leading global hospitality company, spanning the lodging sector from luxurious full-service hotels and resorts to extended-stay suites and mid-priced hotels. For nearly a century, Hilton has offered business and leisure travelers the finest in accommodations, service, amenities and value. Hilton is dedicated to continuing its tradition of providing exceptional guest experiences across its global brands . Our vision “to fill the earth with the light and warmth of hospitality” unites us as a team to create remarkable hospitality experiences around the world every day. And, our amazing Team Members are at the heart of it all!

Promover a cultura de Melhoria Contínua em performance empresarial, Segurança, Saúde, Meio Ambiente e Sustentabilidade (SSMS), atuando rigorosamente em conformidade com o Sistema de Gestão de SSMS da Companhia.

Diffucap Rio de Janeiro, Rio de Janeiro, Brazil

Join to apply for the Gerente de Inteligência de Mercado, Produtividade e Administração de Vendas - Área de Atuação: Rio de Janeiro/RJ ) role at Diffucap

Como é o ambiente de trabalho?

A Diffucap oferece um ambiente de trabalho ético, moderno e colaborativo para profissionais que transformam dados de mercado, prescrição, vendas, produtividade e canais em insights, com estrutura híbrida e foco em resultados sustentáveis.

Os colaboradores contam com autonomia, treinamentos contínuos e suporte tecnológico para suas atividades externas e internas.

A cultura organizacional valoriza o aprendizado, o reconhecimento e o cumprimento das normas éticas da indústria farmacêutica.

O clima é acolhedor, incentivando a comunicação e o desenvolvimento pessoal.

Esse conjunto promove engajamento e alta performance profissional.

Responsabilidades da Oportunidade

Objetivo do Cargo

Ser o líder da área que transforma dados de mercado, prescrição, vendas, produtividade e canais em insights , direcionando decisões estratégicas e táticas para crescimento da Diffucap. Atua como ponte entre inteligência de mercado, vendas e marketing, garantindo que os relatórios suportem o planejamento (incluindo LE trimestral), execução comercial e monitoramento de KPIs de produtividade, demanda e vendas.

Inteligência de Mercado & Prescrição

Desenvolver e manter modelos de mercado, prescrição (RX) e demanda para todas as classes terapêuticas da Diffucap.

Monitorar concorrentes, detectar tendências de mercado (entrada de genéricos, mudança de canais, novas tecnologias administrativas) e transformar em recomendações estratégicas. Exemplos: o desempenho de Deocil (via sublingual), diferenciação via canal digital, etc.

Fornecer relatórios executivos regulares para a liderança (VP Comercial, BD, Marketing) com visão de cenário, oportunidades de expansão e alertas de risco.

Colaborar com a área de Business Development para suportar análise de mercado, atratividade de classes, potencial de prescrição e competitividade.

Produtividade Comercial & Administração de Vendas

Criar e gerir o sistema de segmentação de médicos (quadrante A, B, C, D) baseado em critérios de potencial de prescrição, margem de contribuição e uso crônico — conforme a priorização definida pela liderança comercial.

Definir e monitorar KPIs de produtividade (visitas, repescagem, lançamento, share de voz, share de prescrição), implementando dashboards para vendas, marketing e treinamento.

Revisar e aprimorar os relatórios existentes (vendas e RX) para torná-los simples, intuitivos e com governança para diferentes perfis de usuário.

Garantir a governança dos 3 períodos de LE (Last Expectation) trimestrais: consolidar dados de vendas, despesas, forecast e alinhamento para reporte aos acionistas.

Suporte Estratégico & Processos

Oferecer à liderança, nas reuniões de planejamento anual (ex: plano 2026) e trimestral, o input analítico para tomada de decisão, sem necessariamente definir o “o que cada área deve fazer”, mas esclarecendo “o que o cenário exige”.

Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com Marketing, Marketing Digital, Treinamento, BD e Vendas para traduzir insights em ações — por exemplo, canais digitais complementares, influência, governança de influenciadores.

Estabelecer e manter processos de governança de dados, acesso, qualidade, periodicidade de reporte e visibilidade para todas as áreas relevantes.

Requisitos

Formação Acadêmica

Graduação em Administração, Economia, Engenharia, Farmacêutica ou áreas afins. Pós-graduação ou MBA será diferencial.

Experiência Desejada

Desejável experiência mínima de 5 anos em farmacêutica ou saúde, atuando em Inteligência de Mercado, Estratégia Comercial ou Analytics.

Competências Técnicas

Habilidade analítica avançada: Excel, Power BI/Tableau, modelagem de cenários, previsão de mercado.

Forte comunicação e influência — capacidade de apresentar insights estratégicos para alta liderança e converter em planos de ação.

Mentalidade estratégica, colaborativa e orientada para resultados — capaz de trabalhar em ambiente dinâmico, com ambiguidade e múltiplos stakeholders.

Domínio de inglês (escrita e fala) será diferencial.

Competências Essenciais

Visão de mercado e competitiva (capacidade de identificar oportunidades e riscos).

Transformação de dados brutos em recomendações claras e aplicáveis.

Governança de métricas, qualidade de dados e sistemas de inteligência.

Habilidade em estruturar relatórios e dashboards para diferentes níveis (Executivo, Operacional).

Influência cross-funcional — marketing, vendas, BD, treinamento, TI.

Proatividade e adaptabilidade — ambiência de rebranding e definição de posicionamento da empresa.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Interagir com Classe/Bandeira, atendendo inspeções, respondendo findings, comprovando correções e mantendo dossiês técnicos para auditorias e vistorias.

  • Coordenar SIMOPS e logística de inspeções, planejando janelas, alinhando AHTS/apoio, e privilegiar soluções “no dive” sempre que possível.

  • Padronizar normas e procedimentos internos, redigindo e atualizando procedimentos para casco, amarras e offloading; treinar equipes e garantir aderência.

  • Gerir terceiros e QA/QC, qualificando fornecedores, conduzindo kick offs, supervisionando execução, validando relatórios com evidências e KPIs e promovendo a execução com total segurança.

  • Documentar e medir desempenho, mantendo o SAP e repositório técnico atualizados com planos, certificados, relatórios, e registros de anomalias; reportar KPIs de integridade e conformidade.


Requisitos e qualificações
Formação Acadêmica

  • Graduação completa em Engenharia Naval, Engenharia Mecânica ou áreas correlatas.

  • Registro ativo no CREA.

  • Pós-graduação ou MBA em Engenharia de Confiabilidade, Gestão de Ativos, Projetos ou áreas afins será considerado um diferencial.


Conhecimentos Técnicos Específicos

  • Sólido conhecimento em normas técnicas e regulatórias aplicáveis à integridade de ativos offshore, API, ASME, DNV, ABS e normas da Marinha do Brasil.

  • Domínio de metodologias de inspeção baseadas em risco (RBI), análise de falhas (RCFA), gestão de anomalias e planos de inspeção e teste (ITP).


Ferramentas e Sistemas

  • Experiência avançada com SAP PM para gestão de manutenção e inspeções, ferramentas de análise de dados como Excel avançado e Power BI, além de softwares de engenharia e modelagem estrutural (ex: AutoPIPE, ANSYS, OrcaFlex). Familiaridade com ferramentas de gestão de projetos (MS Project, Primavera) e sistemas de controle de MOCs e não conformidades.


Certificações e Treinamentos Regulatórios

  • Treinamentos obrigatórios para atuação offshore (CBSP, HUET, NR-10, NR-35, entre outros) devem estar atualizados conforme exigência legal.


Idiomas

  • Inglês avançado para leitura e fala, interpretação de normas técnicas internacionais, elaboração de relatórios e comunicação com entidades certificadoras e fornecedores.

Corporate Recruiter at TOPIC Embedded Systems

At TOPIC (in the Netherlands) we work every day on high‑tech innovations to make the world smarter, healthier, and better. Are you a highly driven and ambitious Hardware Test & Verification Designer with a passion for designing, developing, and executing cutting‑edge hardware testing, and ready to make a real impact on product quality and innovation?

“There is a lot of flexibility to educate yourself.”

Gijs van Esch I Hardware Engineer at TOPIC Embedded Systems

What will you do as a Hardware Test & Verification Designer?

As a Hardware Test & Verification Designer you are responsible for designing, developing, and executing hardware testing and validation for complex embedded systems. Applies strong electronics knowledge (schematics, PCB design, signal behavior) to optimize performance and identify issues. Develops and maintains automated test scripts (Python required; LabVIEW, TestStand, or C/C++ preferred) and conducts HIL, reliability, and environmental testing.

Your responsibilities as a Hardware Test & Verification Designer:

  • Design, develop, and execute hardware testing, validation, and verification activities for embedded systems, ensuring product reliability and compliance;
  • Apply a solid understanding of electronics, schematics, PCB design, and signal behavior to identify potential issues and optimize hardware performance;
  • Conduct and support HIL (Hardware‑in‑the‑Loop) testing, as well as reliability and environmental qualification testing;
  • Collaborate closely with embedded software and firmware teams; a hands‑on programming mindset is preferred;
  • Work in a structured, plan‑oriented manner, maintaining high accuracy in documentation, traceability, and reporting;
  • Take a consultative approach, translating test results into clear and valuable recommendations for design improvements and product optimization;
  • Act as a technical consultant, capable of operating across different customer environments to ensure quality, robustness, and regulatory compliance of embedded hardware products.

What do we offer you?

This will make you smarter:

  • Strategic projects in complex high‑tech environments
  • Collaborate with other senior engineers and domain experts
  • Access to advanced training through our TOPIC Academy
  • Contribute to and lead tech events and knowledge sessions

This will make you better:

  • Permanent contract
  • An all‑in benefits package (€62,000 – €82,000 annually) including 13th month, mobility, pension, extra holidays
  • 26 vacation days (option to buy extra), pension scheme, relocation support

This will keep you healthy:

  • Good work‑life balance, flexible hours, and hybrid working
  • Inspiring office with daily fresh fruit and a gym
  • Home office support for an inspiring work‑from‑home setup
  • Regular fun, social, and sports events

What do you bring as a Hardware Test & Verification Designer?

  • A Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electronics, Computer Science, Embedded Systems, or a related technical field;
  • 5+ years in hardware testing, validation, and verification;
  • Strong understanding of electronics, schematics, PCB design, and signal behavior;
  • Proficient in Python (required); experience with LabVIEW, TestStand, or C/C++ is a plus;
  • Familiarity with HIL testing, reliability testing, and environmental testing;
  • Affinity with embedded software and firmware; hands‑on programming skills are preferred;
  • Plan‑oriented and accurate, with strong skills in documentation, traceability, and reporting;
  • Able to interpret test results and translate them into actionable recommendations;
  • Comfortable acting as a technical consultant across various customer environments, ensuring the quality, reliability, and compliance of embedded hardware products;
  • A good command of English, and preferably Dutch language.

Our organization

Since 1996 we have been developing (embedded) systems that are essential for products manufactured by renowned high‑tech companies around the world. Our projects involve edge to cloud solutions; from PCB design and FPGA to low level embedded software and application software for UI, Web, Mobile and cloud. We are well known for our high level of knowledge and expertise and are proud to be a Premier Embedded Computing Partner of AMD; technology leader in the field of System‑on‑Chips and FPGAs.

Diversity & Inclusion

At TOPIC, we believe that true innovation happens when people with different backgrounds, ideas, and perspectives come together. Every talent counts, and every voice matters. Diversity strengthens our creativity, and inclusion ensures that everyone feels welcome and valued. We build a culture where everyone has the space to contribute and be themselves.

Job Description

We are looking for a Web Analyst to join our team and help us optimize the performance of over 25 B2B websites. As a key member for the web team, you will be responsible for analyzing user behavior, tracking key website metrics, and providing actionable insights to improve MQL generation and conversion rates. Your work will directly impact our ability to make informed decisions and improve the performance of our websites.

Key Responsibilities
  • Analyze and report on website performance, focusing on conversion rates, form submissions, and user engagement.
  • Interpret data from website tracking tools (Google Analytics, VWO, Hubspot).
  • Setting and ideation for web events based on business objectives.
  • Develop and maintain dashboards to provide real‑time insights into website performance and translate data into clear, actionable recommendations for the marketing team (LookerStudio, Superset).
  • Conducting A/B testing analyses (VWO and HubSpot).
  • One‑off analysis for key initiatives like Back Friday campaign, promotions, product launches, website migrations to measure effectiveness.
  • Identify and analyze different audience segments to improve targeting and personalization.
  • Work closely with stakeholders to ensure that tracking plans are in place for all key user behaviors.
  • Collaborate with the content team to provide data driven insights that inform content creation and optimize engagement from key user segments.
Qualifications
  • 3+ years experience in web analytics, digital marketing, or CRO roles.
  • Proficiency in Google Analytics (GA4), Google Tag Manager, Looker Studio, or other web analytics platforms.
  • Ability to build dashboards and reports using Looker, Tableau, Superset or similar tools.
  • Experience with A/B testing tools like Google Optimize, VWO, or Optimizely.
  • Experience with Hotjar, Clarity, or other user behavior tracking tools.
  • Experience with Search Console or other SEO tracking tools is a plus.
  • Experience working in a fast paced, dynamic environment.

Engenheiro de Segurança do Trabalho – Limppano – Rio de Janeiro

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Principais Responsabilidades:
Análise de Riscos:
Realizar inspeções e auditorias periódicas para identificar riscos e perigos nos ambientes de trabalho, avaliando condições de segurança e saúde.
Elaborar relatórios técnicos sobre as condições de segurança e propor melhorias.
Elaboração de Programas de Segurança:
Desenvolver e implementar programas de prevenção de acidentes, conforme as normativas regulamentadoras da NR (Normas Regulamentadoras) do Ministério do Trabalho.
Gerenciar os planos de emergência, procedimentos de evacuação e planos de primeiros socorros.
Treinamentos e Capacitação:
Conduzir treinamentos periódicos sobre segurança do trabalho para todos os níveis de colaboradores, incluindo a formação de brigadas de emergência e simulados de evacuação.
Garantir que os colaboradores recebam as orientações corretas sobre o uso de equipamentos de proteção individual (EPIs) e coletivos (EPCs).
Consultoria Técnica:
Prestar orientação técnica sobre as melhores práticas de segurança e saúde ocupacional, assessorar líderes e equipes sobre a implementação de medidas preventivas, conforme as regulamentações vigentes.
Acompanhar a correta utilização de EPIs e EPCs pelos trabalhadores.
Investigação de Acidentes e Incidentes:
Analisar acidentes de trabalho e incidentes, identificando as causas e propondo ações corretivas e preventivas para evitar recorrências.
Elaborar relatórios detalhados sobre os acidentes, conforme exigências legais, e sugerir melhorias nos processos para garantir a segurança dos colaboradores.
Monitoramento de Indicadores de Segurança:
Acompanhar e analisar indicadores de segurança (taxa de acidentes, ausência por problemas de saúde relacionados ao trabalho, etc.) e propor planos de ação corretivos para redução de acidentes e doenças ocupacionais.
Apresentar relatórios e resultados à liderança da empresa, sugerindo melhorias contínuas.
Compliance e Conformidade Regulamentar:
Assegurar o cumprimento das normas legais e regulamentares relacionadas à segurança do trabalho, como as NR’s, além das regulamentações específicas da empresa ou do setor.
Manter-se atualizado sobre as mudanças nas normas de segurança e saúde ocupacional, implementando as alterações necessárias.
Gestão de Documentação e Licenças:
Organizar e controlar a documentação exigida por órgãos reguladores e auditores (relatórios, certificados de capacitação, licenças, etc.).
Manter registros atualizados de treinamentos, inspeções e procedimentos.

Requisitos e Qualificações

Formação: Superior completo em Engenharia de Segurança do Trabalho.
Experiência: Com experiência comprovada em implementação de programas de segurança, investigação de acidentes e gestão de riscos.
Certificação: Registro no CREA (Conselho Regional de Engenharia e Agronomia).
Conhecimentos Técnicos:
Profundo conhecimento das Normas Regulamentadoras (NR’s), principalmente NR-01, NR-06, NR-09, NR-10, NR-12, NR-35, entre outras.
Conhecimento em gestão de riscos, análise de perigos, e sistemas de gestão de segurança do trabalho.
Noções de ergonomia, higiene ocupacional e primeiros socorros.
Habilidades Comportamentais:
Boa comunicação para conduzir treinamentos e interagir com colaboradores e lideranças.
Capacidade de análise crítica e tomada de decisão.
Proatividade e compromisso com a melhoria contínua da segurança.
Espírito de equipe e capacidade de influenciar positivamente os demais colaboradores quanto à importância da segurança do trabalho.

WHY JOIN US

If you’re looking for a place to grow, make an impact, and work with people who care, we’d love to meet you!

ABOUT THE ROLE

As a Product Manager, you’ll define strategy, lead teams, and deliver digital products that engage millions of users worldwide. Combining data‑driven insights with market knowledge, you’ll shape product vision, mentor peers, and collaborate across functions. This role offers high impact, growth, and the chance to influence the future of digital media.

WHAT YOU WILL DO
  • Product Strategy – Develop and communicate a clear product strategy and vision for IGN’s digital platforms and products, aligning it with the company’s goals and objectives
  • Product Leadership – Lead multiple product teams and drive product strategy for a larger portfolio of products.
  • Team Leadership – Lead and mentor a team of product managers, providing guidance and support to help them achieve their goals and deliver high‑quality products.
  • Product Roadmap – Define and maintain the product roadmap for multiple products, ensuring it aligns with business priorities, user needs, and market trends. Make data‑driven decisions and prioritize features accordingly.
  • Cross‑Functional Collaboration – Collaborate with cross‑functional teams, including engineering, design, editorial, and marketing, to ensure successful product development and delivery.
  • User Research – Conduct and analyze user research to gain a deep understanding of user needs, preferences, and pain points. Use this data to inform product decisions and improvements.
  • User Experience (UX) – Work with UX/UI designers to create user‑friendly and visually appealing products. Ensure a seamless and engaging user experience across IGN’s digital platforms.
  • Data Analysis – Utilize data analytics and key performance indicators (KPIs) to monitor product performance, identify areas for improvement, and make data‑driven decisions to optimize the product.
  • Product Development – Oversee the end‑to‑end product development process, from ideation to release. Coordinate with development teams to deliver high‑quality products on schedule.
  • Project Management – Define and prioritize product features, enhancements, and requirements based on customer feedback, market research, and business impact. Collaborate with product managers to ensure that product feature prioritization aligns with the overall product strategy and roadmap.
  • Product Launch – Plan and execute successful product launches, including marketing strategies and user communication. Monitor product performance post‑launch and iterate based on user feedback.
  • Stakeholder Communication – Keep stakeholders informed about the status of ongoing projects, milestones, and potential roadblocks. Maintain transparency and ensure alignment with business goals.
  • Market and Competitive Analysis – Stay informed about industry trends, emerging technologies, and the competitive landscape to identify opportunities and threats in the market.
  • User Feedback and Support – Engage with user feedback, reviews, and support channels to address user concerns, gather insights, and drive product improvements.

  • Led product development on complex features from 1st to Nth interaction
  • A history of deep, and demonstrated understanding of the techniques and methods of modern product discovery and product delivery
  • Demonstrated ability to figure out solutions to hard problems with many constraints, using sound judgment to assess risks, and to lay out your argument in a well‑structured, data‑informed, written narrative
  • Proven ability to engage with engineers, designers, and company leaders in a constructive and collaborative relationship

NICE TO HAVES

description:
Job description

A Aegea

Criada em 2010, a Aegea é líder no setor privado de saneamento básico no Brasil. Em cada município onde atua, leva mais saúde e qualidade de vida para a população, respeitando sempre o meio ambiente e a cultura local.

A Concessionária

A Águas do Rio, concessionária da Aegea é responsável pelo abastecimento de água e esgotamento sanitário em 27 municípios do estado do Rio de Janeiro, incluindo 124 bairros da capital, atendendo 10 milhões de pessoas.

Durante o período de concessão, iniciado em 1º de novembro de 2021, a companhia realizou o maior investimento em saneamento básico no país, em torno de R$ 39 bilhões. R$ 15,4 bilhões em outorga, para serem aplicados em projetos prioritários dos governos estadual e municipais, e R$ 24,4 bilhões para a universalização dos serviços de água e esgoto, que será alcançada nos primeiros 12 anos, em alinhamento ao novo Marco Regulatório de Saneamento.

Programa Respeito dá o Tom

O programa nasceu com a meta de espelhar a demografia da população brasileira no quadro de funcionários da empresa.

Em 2022 a Aegea emitiu um título sustentável atrelado a metas que incluem alcançar 45% de mulheres e 27% de negros em cargos de liderança até 2030, sendo pioneira em se comprometer com meta de diversidade racial em cargos de liderança.

A Aegea tem o compromisso com a promoção de um ambiente de trabalho mais igualitário, diverso e inclusivo, e estimula o respeito e a valorização das diferenças.

Aqui, todos os candidatos qualificados serão considerados no processo seletivo, independentemente de raça, gênero, orientação sexual, religião, naturalidade, nacionalidade, deficiência, idade ou outras características.

Main responsibilities
  • Coordenar o planejamento e o controle operacional, garantindo alinhamento entre as metas de eficiência e o orçamento da companhia;
  • Acompanhar e analisar indicadores de desempenho (KPIs), elaborando diagnósticos e planos de ação que impulsionem resultados;

  • Estruturar relatórios e apresentações gerenciais, traduzindo dados complexos em informações estratégicas;
  • Atuar próximo às superintendências, fortalecendo a cultura de performance e eficiência.
Requirements and skills
  • Formação superior em Engenharia, Administração, Economia ou áreas correlatas;
  • Experiência em planejamento e controle voltado para eficiência operacional, preferencialmente em empresas de grande porte, com unidades descentralizadas;
  • Vivência prévia com gestão de pessoas e processos;
  • Conhecimento em análise de custos, orçamento e indicadores de desempenho;
  • Perfil analítico, firme e orientado a resultados, com excelente comunicação e capacidade de articulação entre áreas.

title: Financial Applications Director
description:
Conservation International protects nature for the benefit of humanity. Through science, policy, fieldwork, and finance, we spotlight and secure the most important places in nature for the climate, biodiversity, and for people. With offices in 30 countries and projects in more than 100 countries, Conservation International partners with governments, companies, civil society, Indigenous peoples, and local communities to help people and nature thrive together.

Position Summary

This position is based in Arlington-VA (hybrid), Bogota-Colombia (hybrid) or Brazil (fully remote). This position is responsible for the administration of CI’s financial accounting systems: Unit4 Business World and Concur. The Financial Applications Director ensures optimal use of these systems and their related applications and plays a leading role in the integration of these systems with other CI databases relating to financial data and processes. This role also provides training to users, maintains security, and troubleshoots application issues for both US and field-based staff.

Responsibilities
  • Systems Support
  • Responsible for all aspects of end-user support for financial systems, including:
    • Hands-on resolution of tickets, including documentation in the ticketing system and communication with affected staff and IT stakeholders.
    • Communication with software vendors for issues that cannot be resolved internally.
    • Management of other support staff and coordination with business process owners and other team members as needed to resolve tickets.
    • Oversee creation, maintenance, and termination of user accounts in financial systems. Conduct periodic security audits as required.
    • Create and manage complex workflow processes for appropriate systems, including troubleshooting and maintenance.
    • Design special-purpose reports and processes utilizing SQL Server, Business World reporting tools, or other tools as required for audits or other management uses. This includes Business World AG16’s (SQL-based customizations). Manage design, test, and maintain custom reports and forms in Business World using ARC (Agresso Report Creator). This includes complex reports such as the check and the purchase order form.
    • Create and maintain security roles for both menu and reporting (data) access.
  • System Maintenance, Enhancements, and Vendor Management
  • Ensure financial systems are up to date and used to maximum effect:
  • Lead or participate in identifying system improvements, modifications, and enhancements that will streamline processes, increase efficiency, and provide needed functionality.
  • Develop and maintain interfaces to other systems as needed.
  • Serve as the Business World applications ‘go-to’ person by researching software functionality, staying current on technology changes, and advising on best practices.
  • Test patches to ensure that they resolve issues as intended. Work with systems software vendors and CI’s IT department to facilitate the migration of patches to production that have passed testing. Create/maintain system configuration as needed to ensure optimal processing.
  • Maintain and manage relationships with financial systems, software, and service vendors to ensure strong working relationships, maximized levels of support, and efficient use of CI’s resources.
  • Documentation and Training
  • Develop and maintain financial systems SharePoint resource site(s) with relevant help materials for end users.
  • Draft and update financial systems user and administrative procedures as needed.
  • Conduct training for end users as required.
  • Project Management/Change Management
  • Manage financial systems team meetings. Coordinate with business process owners, super users, and other team members as needed to ensure good communication on all financial system-related issues.
  • Manage the change management system to ensure all changes to production financial systems are properly documented, approved, tested, and implemented.

Other duties as assigned by the supervisor.

Working Conditions
  • Normal office environment.
  • Guidance on flexible work arrangements will be shared during the interview process.
QualificationsRequired
  • Bachelor’s degree in a related field.
  • 7 or more years of related experience.
  • 2 or more years of supervisory experience.
  • Strong knowledge of Financial Applications, including General Ledger, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Contract Accounting, Operating Budget, Project Management, and Procurement modules.
  • Solid working knowledge of database architecture and management
  • SQL Server and Visual Basic experience
  • Experience with ERP reporting tools
  • Ability to adapt and work effectively with functional teams across the organization.
  • Understanding of accounting processes and standards.
  • Experience in training on software applications.
  • Preferred
  • Administrator experience using Unit4 Business World
  • Fluency in Spanish, Portuguese, Indonesian, and/or French

description:
Job description

Nossa história resume bem o que somos: uma combinação entre nosso potencial e a dedicação de quem acredita que limites existem para serem superados.

Sabemos que para ganhar o jogo precisamos dos melhores talentos e estamos aqui para jogar a longo prazo. Por isso, procuramos pessoas que queiram evoluir continuamente e se desafiar a construir algo relevante para nossos clientes.

Foram a ambição e o trabalho dos nossos associados que nos trouxeram até aqui e que continuarão a nos levar adiante. Por isso, buscamos os melhores profissionais, que sejam obcecados por gerar resultados através do time, liderando uma equipe de alta performance.

Se identificou? Então venha fazer parte do nosso time!

Main responsibilities

Como Supervisor de Prevenção de Perdas, você fará:

  • Visitas em loja: responsável por realizar auditorias presenciais das rotinas e processos em um grupo específico de lojas, efetuando as correções e ajustes necessários para assegurar o controle e a redução de perdas e quebras nas localidades, conforme metas pré-estabelecidas.
  • Tratativa dos indicadores críticos: responsável por monitorar, através de painel de indicadores e imagens, as informações atreladas a perdas e quebras das lojas, identificando possíveis desvios e agindo proativamente para corrigi-los.
  • Investigação de fraudes e desvios: responsável por apurar fraudes, quebras de procedimentos e desvios de mercadorias nas lojas através do canal de denúncias, visitas em loja e análise do painel de indicadores.
  • Acompanhamento de inventário: Responsável por acompanhar a organização e preparo das lojas para a realização de inventários, diagnosticando os resultados e elaborando um plano de ação junto às lojas para melhorar esses resultados.
  • Acompanhamento dos resultados: responsável por realizar reuniões semanais, quinzenais e/ou mensais para atualizar e apresentar resultados, discutir estratégias, e treinar a equipe de prevenção e os associados das lojas nos procedimentos preventivos.
  • Atuação em sinistros: responsável por identificar e implementar ações para mitigar e reduzir ocorrências de sinistros em determinadas localidades, além de fornecer o suporte necessário à loja após um sinistro, garantindo a execução adequada do procedimento pós-sinistro e prevenindo possíveis reincidências.
Requirements and skills

Você deve ter os seguintes requisitos:

  • Graduação completa;
  • Domínio do pacote office – Intermediário/avançado;
  • Habilidade analítica e estratégica;
  • Boa comunicação e capacidade de negociação;
  • Perfil direcionado a resultados;
  • Senso de urgência;
  • Disponibilidade para viagens.

Será um diferencial se você possuir:

  • Conhecimento prévio em Prevenção de Perdas;
  • Vivência com Looker ou Power BI;
  • Conhecimento com sistemas de CFTV;
  • Vivência com SAP.

Local de Trabalho:

  • Disponibilidade para trabalhar em Rio de Janeiro - RJ .
Additional information

  • Somos adeptos ao regime e benefícios CLT, oferecemos:
  • Vale Refeição;

  • Plano odontológico;
  • Wellhub;

  • Meetups e eventos com muita troca de conhecimento e uma plataforma interna com diversos cursos e treinamentos;

Estamos em busca de um Operador de Máquinas para se juntar à nossa equipe na Brasanitas. Este é um papel fundamental em nossa operação, onde você será responsável por operar e supervisionar diversas máquinas de fabricação e processamento.

Por aqui, vivemos nossa cultura no dia a dia, guiados por esses 5 pilares:

Você será o principal parceiro estratégico dos empreendedores mais influentes da sua região, realizando um diagnóstico financeiro profundo de cada negócio. Com base nessa análise, você desenhará e implementará estratégias de crédito personalizadas, integrando-as a um ecossistema completo de soluções Stone em finanças, software e gestão. Seu objetivo é garantir não apenas a melhor solução de crédito, mas uma experiência de excelência que impulsione de forma decisiva o sucesso e a competitividade dos nossos clientes.

title: Product Director, Feegow (100% remote-friendly within Brazil)
description:
Product Director, Feegow (100% remote-friendly within Brazil)

BRL 200.000 - 250.000

Company Description

Welcome to the good side of tech

You might have heard about us but with a different name: Feegow, Doctoralia or Docplanner. The names are different depending on the country we are located in, but we are all part of Docplanner Group.

It all started over 12 years ago when we asked ourselves: is anyone in healthcare thinking about patients? We jumped in and we empowered patients by giving them access to leave and read reviews about their visit. We then provided doctors with the technology to manage bookings easily and save time, so they could devote themselves to what they always wanted: treating patients. And today is the day in which we ask you: wanna join us in the next step helping people live longer and healthier lives?

Where does Feegow fit here?

In 2022 Feegow joined the Docplanner Group, a health-tech company. We are dedicated to developing innovative solutions and promoting access to top-tier management for physicians seeking to take their practices to the next level, as well as managers in search of a robust solution that covers end-to-end operations. Our ultimate goal is to create a world where everyone can access high-quality healthcare.

Docplanner Group at scale

We are leaders in 13 countries so far, and more than 50 million patients trust us every month. 300.000+ specialists believe in us and our product, and so do leading venture capital funds such as Point Nine Capital, Goldman Sachs Asset Management and One Peak Partners. And yet, employing over 2.500 people all over the globe, we managed to keep the startup-mindset we started with over 12 years ago.

And why should you join us?

Because it feels good to tell your family and your friends how you made the world a little bit better. You go to bed knowing that what you do matters, and that your talents align with your beliefs.

We want to make the healthcare experience more human, and that starts with you being you. We believe that considering the diversity of human experience makes a better healthcare experience for all. We’re not just different: we embrace diversity. We will encourage you to come to work your whole self, and that includes not coming to the office at all if you prefer not to, as we\'re 100% remote-friendly.

Remote model: you can work 100% from home, but you are also welcome in our offices in Curitiba and Rio de Janeiro.

Job Description

Feegow is the leading Practice Management System (PMS) in Brazil for individual doctors & large clinics alike, and a highly strategic product for Docplanner Group, as a foundation to conquer the Brazilian market.

We are looking for a passionate and experienced Director of Product for Feegow to lead our product teams, drive innovation, accountability, and play a key role in our product\'s modernization. This is a remote-friendly role within Brazil, where you’ll foster collaboration between global teams, steer product development, and manage a talented product team. Your expertise in building a data-driven & business minded product culture whilst delivering fast & safe iterations, knowing when to go for PoCs & robust solutions based on the business appetite and product maturity will ensure the continued growth of Feegow and Docplanner Group.

What we expect from this position:

  • Inspire, lead and bring in PMS product vision to all product managers and teams.
  • Understand a complex environment where the teams have not only individual doctors and clinics that should be delighted with their Efficiency platform, whilst bringing them new value propositions like Visibility & Growth, as well as betting on AI as a door opener for exponential value.
  • Define with PMs the product strategy on every team, how it relates to the broader Brazilian strategy & Docplanner Tech & Product strategy.
  • Influence and establish a shared vision with other business areas as Sales, Operations and Marketing. Be a key stakeholder for Individuals and Clinics Business owners.
  • Ensure upcoming product needs and opportunities aligned with your Engineering Director and Country Managers to create a coherent Product & Tech Strategy and Roadmap.
  • Champion a hands-on approach to innovation by using a combination of Data, listening to the market, and “getting out of the building” to get first-hand customer/user insights.
  • Create a culture of decision-making based on insight, analysis and data across the business.
  • Work closely with our Global VP Product, on standardizing the objectives in clear indicators & tasks and bring transparency on ‘the plan’ across the whole company.
Qualifications
  • Minimum 3 years’ work experience as Product Director / GPM (managing and coaching a group of Product Managers)
  • Experience on B2B SaaS scale-ups
  • Solid experience in fast high-growth environment, change management, & business growth
  • A proven track record of delivering significant success, scaling and developing high performing digital products that impact business & delight customers
  • Expertise in the end-to-end product development lifecycle, agile and lean software development practices
  • An entrepreneurial mindset with outstanding organizational, communicative and leadership skills
  • Business savvy, holistic business acumen outside of Product Management and ability to assess product market fit
  • Analytical abilities and problem-solving skills
  • Experience in healthcare is a plus not a must
  • Experience in modernizing tech debt whilst delivering product value is a plus
  • Hands-on: In Docplanner, being a people manager does not mean only managing people, but being able to dive in the details of problems, opportunities & solutions.
Additional Information

What will you get in return?

Let’s talk money

  • A salary adequate to your experience and skills between R$37,000and R$44.500. Your salary will be, now and always, 100% transparent to you;
  • 100% remote-friendly within Brazil
  • Working hours are from Monday to Friday, from 9 am to 6 pm;
  • We have compensatory time off (Banco de Horas);
  • Food/Market Voucher;
  • Medical, Dental, and Group Life Insurance;
  • Pet Plan;
  • iFeel app, for emotional comfort;
  • Gympass for you and up to 3 people!
  • Creditas: Payroll loan services, eligible after 6 months of employment;
  • Stock Options- eligible after 6 months of employment (5 years grace period)
  • Birthday Day Off;
  • Partnership Club, with discounts ranging from teaching institutions, such as colleges and language learning services;
  • Referral Program offers up to R$600 per person who stays with us for more than 6 months;
  • Leave of Absence/Time-off: in the event of the passing of loved ones, we offer 10 days off; if your pet passes away, we offer 2 days. Got married? 7 days of rest! Did the baby arrive? We offer 30 days for Dads and 6 months for Moms;

title: Design Director, UI/UX & Brand
description:
Darkroom is a technology-driven growth marketing firm focused on growth-stage consumer companies. We were founded in 2017 out of a conviction that the iconic ad agencies of tomorrow would look very different. Darkroom is a human services firm built on a universal AI commerce layer called Matter. Our model deploys a unique blend of senior, human resources enriched by an agentic technology stack that enhances output, efficiency, and revenue generation for our clients.

Our team has been responsible for billions of dollars in trackable revenue across the various e-commerce marketplace, direct-to-consumer, and social commerce programs under management. Using research aggregated across these engagements, we accelerate results for our portfolio by developing high-impact digital strategies that unlock gateways to revenue growth, transform marketing operations, and prioritize profitability.

What started as a boutique design agency evolved into one of the fastest-growing private companies in America (Inc. 5000), one of the most successful results-driven performance media agencies of the 2020s (Varos), and esteemed recognition by Forbes 30 Under 30 for our founders’ contribution in Marketing & Advertising (Forbes).

About the Role

We are hiring a Design Director - a visionary leader with a strong design background who thrives in driving high-quality design execution across various platforms as well as managing creative talent. You’ll combine strategic oversight with hands‑on involvement, ensuring that every design project meets the highest standards of excellence.

That role requires deep experience in branded UI/UX design. You’re a senior-level design lead that can independently own multiple web design engagements simultaneously. Navigating client feedback and pushback is an everyday muscle you successfully work with. You can show deep experience in being able to thread the needle between game‑changing UI, conversion‑oriented UX, and technical feasibility, all on a tight timeline. Clients are consistently impressed by your knowledge of e-commerce heuristics and how you combine that with unique and branded design. You love working with developers to understand how to make your ideas come to life and sell clients on design solutions and tradeoffs they have to make to complete engagements on‑time.

You pride yourself on being able to effortlessly spin up a new brand design system for a client that feels differentiated, elevated, and informed by your strategic market analysis. You have consistently merged business thinking with exceptional visual craft into scalable brand identities that work across paid media, retention, web, social, and packaging.

In addition to your individual contributor responsibilities, you will report to the Director of Creative and play a key role in guiding a talented team of designers, overseeing the delivery of exceptional designs for paid ads, emails, landing pages, and e-commerce web design. With your deep expertise in UI/UX and brand design, you’ll empower your team to elevate their skills while maintaining a high bar for creative output and attention to detail.

This role requires a balance of creativity, business strategy, and leadership in a fast-paced, collaborative environment. You’ll work closely with marketing, product, and development teams to ensure the alignment of design goals with broader business objectives. Your ability to drive creative strategy and manage multiple projects with precision will be essential to your success. Darkroom is a career incubator for ambitious talent looking to operate at the intersection of business, design, and innovation.

This is a fully remote role operating in the EST Time Zone and all business is conducted 100% in English.

Lead 1-3 UI/UX engagements as needed, focusing on creating branded e-commerce websites.

Emphasize branded UI, conversion‑focused UX, and clarity in design approaches.

Present design work to clients, explaining design choices based on effective reasoning and UX principles.

Manage design projects independently from discovery to hand‑off, adhering to timelines and collaborating with developers to ensure feasibility.

Develop component systems and maintain design guidelines for consistency.

Management Responsibilities:

Manage a team of designers, starting with 2-4 direct reports and expanding as the team grows. Provide support in strategy, project management, design feedback, performance evaluation, and handling escalations.

Conduct weekly 1:1s with direct reports to assess client health, offer feedback, and oversee career development.

Ensure high-quality work output from direct reports, focusing on visual craft, UX expertise, and meeting deadlines.

Collaborate with cross‑functional teams, including marketers, strategists, developers, and clients, to develop project plans, understand business objectives, and address client issues.

Refine internal processes for client work in coordination with the Director of Creative. Provide training and feedback to enhance the skills of the design team.

You Should Apply if this Sounds Like You:

3-6+ years of senior‑level web design experience with e‑commerce companies, with at least 1 year of people management experience preferred. Must have experience in responsive web design.

Digital portfolio showcasing web design and branding skills, including color theory, hierarchy, composition, and typography.

Self‑motivated, proactive, and detail‑oriented with a strong sense of ownership.

Experience collaborating with developers and documenting designs for development hand‑off.

Comfortable with client‑facing responsibilities in English, including leading discovery calls and resolving client feedback.

Capable of providing constructive internal feedback and guiding direct reports to improve their work.

Ability to tackle ambiguous problems, understand business challenges, design solutions, and execute them effectively.

Proficiency in Figma, including features like Auto Layout, Components, and Variants, is essential.

Experience with Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator) is required.

Bonus: Familiarity with HTML/CSS or frameworks like Tailwind.

Working at Darkroom

Darkroom is not a typical agency. We are looking for A players that want to build something great. There is no room in our organization for mediocrity and candidates that are not at the top of their game do not last. We move fast, think deeply, and expect every team member to bring insight and rigor to everything they touch. We hold a high bar for performance, creativity, and ownership — but we also support each other relentlessly. No egos, no red tape — just world‑class talent building something remarkable.

We believe in autonomy with accountability , truth over comfort , and outcomes over optics . If you want to build and win alongside some of the smartest people in the business, you’ll thrive here.

Location, location, (or no) location: Remote‑first culture with a strong community base. With Hubs in the Bay Area, New York, Philly, Lisbon, SaoPaulo, and Barcelona!

Parental Leave: flexible parental leave benefits to support new parents during this important transition, ensuring time to bond with their families while maintaining work‑life balance.

Endless opportunities for growth: Our agency is founded on an interdisciplinary approach, giving Darkroomers insights into services far beyond your job description. Grow your skills and interests beyond your niche and stay at the forefront of the industry through total immersion in cross‑functional collaboration.

Equal Opportunity Statement

Darkroom is an equal opportunity workplace—we are dedicated to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national orientation, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, or Veteran status. title: Head Of Finance
description:
You will report to our Chief Operations Officer and join the Finance team. On TheOrg you can view the complete structure of our organisation, including information about every team member, hiring managers, and the size of each department.

We’re looking for a strategic and hands‑on Head Of Finance to lead the transformation of our financial operations into a data‑driven, scalable, and globally compliant structure. The ideal candidate has strong experience in high‑growth tech startups or SaaS companies , thrives in distributed and multicultural teams , and knows how to connect finance, data, and technology to drive intelligent decision‑making. You’ll play a key role in helping Rocket.Chat reach its next stage of maturity — balancing governance, automation, and growth efficiency in a company that powers secure collaboration for clients around the world.

Qualifications
  • Proven experience as CFO, Finance Director, or Head of Finance in startups or tech companies (preferably SaaS or open‑source models).
  • Strong background in FP&A, Controllership, Accounting, and Financial Planning.
  • Hands‑on experience with ERP systems (preferably NetSuite) and financial process automation.
  • Solid understanding of global financial operations, including taxation and compliance in the US, Brazil, and Europe.
  • Solid knowledge of processes and budgetary controls.
  • Proficiency in strategically managing cash balance/runway, financial modelling, forecasting, and performance metrics (MRR, LTV, CAC, churn, margins).
  • Knowledge of international accounting standards (specifically US GAAP).
  • Fluent English communication skills (reports and meetings in English).
  • Proven ability to restructure and develop finance teams, while embedding agile methodologies and governance frameworks to drive process optimization and strategic alignment.
  • Experience in open‑source or hybrid SaaS/enterprise business models.
  • Familiarity with CRM and payment integrations (Zoho, Stripe, Jira).
  • Understanding of data analytics and BI tools (Power BI, Zoho Analytics).
  • Exposure to fundraising, Series A/B stages, M&A and investor relations.
  • Experience collaborating with technical and data teams (e.g., AWS cost efficiency, data pipelines, metric creation).
  • Passion: Genuine enthusiasm for what you do and how it contributes to our mission of enabling secure, open, and collaborative communication worldwide.
  • Dream: Proactively seek opportunities and challenges to achieve extraordinary results — bringing a growth mindset and ambition to scale a global company.
  • Own: Show strong ownership and accountability by taking responsibility for outcomes, maintaining high standards, and fostering both structure and innovation to deliver meaningful impact.
  • Trust: Build trust through reliability and empathy, fostering collaboration across distributed teams and time zones.
  • Share: Communicate openly and transparently, ensuring clarity and honesty in all interactions — especially when connecting finance with data and operations.
  • Self‑Awareness & Growth Mindset: Self‑awareness (desire and ability to constructively critique performance) and ability to identify root‑cause of errors and seek continuous improvement.
Responsibilities
  • Lead the financial transformation of Rocket.Chat — redesigning processes, governance, and structure to support sustainable global growth.
  • Oversee all financial operations (A/P, A/R, treasury, payroll, and accounting – both internal and 3rd‑party service providers); ensuring scalability, accuracy, and compliance.
  • Manage and optimize the company’s investment portfolio, cash position, and asset allocation.
  • Optimize the NetSuite ERP implementation and its integrations with Zoho CRM, Jira, Stripe and other core systems.
  • Build a data‑driven financial planning model, connecting operational and revenue metrics (LTV, CAC, churn, MRR, payback) to decision‑making.
  • Partner closely with GTM, Data, Product, and Operations teams to align financial strategy with business performance.
  • Drive FP&A excellence: forecasting, variance analysis, and business insights for leadership and investors.
  • Lead and mentor a lean finance team (FP&A, Controllership, Treasury, and Payroll), developing ownership and technical excellence.
  • Ensure global compliance, governance, and audit readiness across all financial processes and transactions.
  • Report directly to the COO, contributing as a key voice in strategic planning, funding, and board reporting.
  • Ensure all facility services in the Porto Alegre office are operating effectively, verifying the quality of deliveries, structural needs, and overall functionality, while supervising vendor performance.
  • Maintain communication with the Board and Investor Relations, providing updates, insights, and alignment on key operational and financial matters.
  • Fortify the culture of accountability and ownership in daily operations, ensuring the delivery of defined financial results, maintaining high‑quality standards in financial processes, and fostering continuous improvement.
  • Fully Remote & Flexible Working Hours
  • Flexible Paid Time Off, Holidays and Vacation
  • Company Laptop
  • iTalki, Courses and Books
  • Stock Options
  • Vibrant Company Culture

Rocket.Chat is the world's largest open‑source communications platform. Built for organizations needing more control over their communications, Rocket.Chat Secure CommsOS™ is a communication platform that unifies messaging, voice, video, AI, and mission‑critical applications—ensuring uncompromising security, compliance, and operational efficiency for governments, defense, and critical infrastructure organizations operating in highly‑regulated environments.

Tens of millions of users in over 150 countries and organizations such as Deutsche Bahn, the U.S. Navy and Credit Suisse trust Rocket.Chat every day to keep their communications completely private and secure. As Rocket.Chat we believe in reconnecting the world, one conversation at a time!

description:
Join to apply for the Partner Sales Director - IHV Alliances role at Canonical

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office‑based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in interesting locations around the world to align on strategy and execution.

We are seeking a highly motivated and experienced IHV Alliance Sales Director to join our strategic partnerships team. The role will be based remotely in EMEA or APAC regions and will involve leading IHV Alliances, building and maintaining strong relationships with senior executives at partner organizations, and driving revenue growth and market expansion for Canonical.

Responsibilities
  • Lead IHV Alliances in EMEA or APAC regions, reporting to the Head of IHV Alliances
  • Build and nurture strategic relationships with IHV partners at all levels, including engineering to CxO
  • Manage and grow a team of Business Development Managers, guiding them to identify and pursue new business opportunities with IHVs
  • Develop and execute go‑to‑market strategies for joint offerings, oversee day‑to‑day alliance management, contract negotiations, performance tracking, and issue resolution
  • Demonstrate deep understanding of Linux, cloud software ecosystem, and large complex organizations
  • Lead partnerships in APAC (e.g., Lenovo, Huawei, Quanta, Fujitsu, Inspur, H3C, NEC, Asus) and EMEA (e.g., Ericsson, Nokia, Bull, Siemens) and support initiatives in the Americas (e.g., Dell, HPE, IBM, Supermicro)
  • Collaborate closely with marketing, sales engineering, and product management teams
  • Deliver on targets, objectives, and provide a partner voice to Canonical leadership
  • Lead executive interlocks between IHV and Canonical leadership
  • Travel regularly—sometimes internationally—to drive partnerships in person
Skills & Experience
  • Proven alliance or indirect sales management experience
  • Autonomous, disciplined, hands‑on, get‑it‑done mentality
  • Strong ability to capture customer requirements, evaluate gaps, and create opportunities
  • Passion for Ubuntu products and mission
  • Comfortable in fast‑paced, high‑pressure environments with measurable goals
  • Experience with Linux, virtualization, containers, and other cloud technologies
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills
Benefits
  • Distributed work environment with twice‑yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review and performance‑driven bonus or commission
  • Comprehensive wellbeing and wellness programs, including Team Member Assistance Program
  • Annual holiday leave, maternity and paternity leave, and other statutory benefits
  • Travel upgrades and Priority Pass for long‑haul company events
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations and meet colleagues worldwide

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer. We foster a workplace free from discrimination and celebrate diversity of experience, perspective, and background. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

description:
